cases.name: Compact capability discovery
cases.requirement: The service publishes task-level capability descriptors without requiring clients to load every provider-internal tool schema.

cases.name: One-call free read
cases.requirement: A complete provider-declared read-only request can execute through POST /v1/invoke without Options, quote, payment, or Idempotency-Key.

cases.name: Unsafe direct request fails closed
cases.requirement: A task requiring a quote or separate approval returns contract_required and does not create the provider side effect.

cases.name: Conditional direct idempotency
cases.requirement: Read-only direct work may omit Idempotency-Key; side-effecting or billable direct work requires one before execution.

cases.name: Options is side-effect-free
cases.requirement: POST /v1/options may return relevant fields, flow, permissions, files, and billing choices but creates no quote, billable usage, authority, task, or provider effect.

cases.name: Exact idempotent replay
cases.requirement: An identical mutation under the same scoped key replays the stored response rather than creating a second contract, task, billing record, or provider effect.

cases.name: Idempotency conflict
cases.requirement: The same scoped key with a different request digest is rejected with idempotency_conflict.

cases.name: Unknown outcomes remain locked
cases.requirement: A claim is released only when no contract, billing, task, callback, upload, or provider effect could have occurred; ambiguous outcomes require reconciliation.

cases.name: Digest-bound file upload
cases.requirement: Upload acceptance verifies owner, token, media type, declared size, digest, expiry, readiness, and scan state before a FileRef can affect execution.

cases.name: File metadata enters the signed quote
cases.requirement: Every input FileRef that can affect a contract task is preserved inside the quote signature projection.

cases.name: Service-bound signed quote
cases.requirement: A quote identifies the service, actor, principal, exact task, files, callback, price, billing terms, permissions, effects, data use, confirmation, and expiry.

cases.name: Independent quote-bound authorization
cases.requirement: Natural-language content cannot create authority; commit approval is independently verified and bound to the exact quote digest, principal, audience, and expiry.

cases.name: Multiple billing arrangements
cases.requirement: The service can represent free, pay-now, prepaid, subscription, postpaid, monthly invoice, clearing, sponsored, and external-settlement arrangements without treating every call as immediate payment.

cases.name: Per-call billing only when required
cases.requirement: Commit requires BillingAuthorization only when the signed BillingTerms require it; a verified standing arrangement can omit a per-call payment token.

cases.name: Billing binding and ceiling
cases.requirement: A billing adapter validates service audience, binding digest, arrangement, mode, expiry, usage, and monetary ceiling before reservation or usage recording.

cases.name: No duplicate settlement or over-refund
cases.requirement: Reservation, settlement, release, and refund operations are idempotent; cumulative refunds cannot exceed the settled amount.

cases.name: Signed invocation audit chain
cases.requirement: A direct invocation returns a signed receipt anchored to a verifiable append-only audit hash chain.

cases.name: Signed task audit chain
cases.requirement: A contract task returns a signed completion receipt anchored to a verifiable append-only audit hash chain.
